label: Actualized through: dependence reading versus act reading
resolution: ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1 (DeflatedActualizedBy) reads 'r is actual in x through esse' as 'x has r in act and has being'; ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2 (ActualizationFrame.ActualizedBy) is the act reading, esse as the act by which r is actual. The q.4 a.1 ad 3 first 'unde' bridge DependenceIsActualization is stated with ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2; on ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_1 it holds in every frame (undeLoadMap), so a passage from its dependence ground to the act reading is exactly the step at issue. Each argument uses one sense; the load map and controls are premise-free sense-mixing controls.
